decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - Approved Plans - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: [DWG NO N/01
DWG NO N/02
DWG NO N/06
DWG NO N/07
DWG NO N/08
]

Condition : 3 - Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No Use of Flat Roof  - Access to the flat roof of the development hereby permitted shall be for maintenance or emergency purposes only, and the flat roof shall not be used as a roof garden, terrace, patio or similar amenity area.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby permitted shall not be rented, sold independently or occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the main residential use of the dwelling known as 3 Edgehill Road Mitcham CR4 2HY

Condition : 6 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant -Approved Schemes
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Borough of Merton (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to the delivery of sustainable development, by:
1. Providing a formal pre-application advice service, details to be found on Planning pre-application advice service on LBM's website
2. Providing written policies and guidance, which is available to view on LBM's website.
3. Where appropriate, negotiating amendments to secure a positive decision.
4. Determining applications in a timely manner including providing a fast track service, details to be found on Get a quicker planning decision on LBM's website.

In this instance:
i) The application was acceptable as submitted, and approved without delay.

Condition : 7 - INFORMATIVE
Building Regulations 
Please note that this is a planning permission only and you may also require approval under the Building Regulations. If you are in any doubt about this you can get further information via https://www.merton.gov.uk/planning-and-buildings/building-control  or by emailing building.control@merton.gov.uk.

Reason : 1 - The proposed outbuilding by reason of design, height, massing, form, siting and use, would fail to achieve a high standard of design and incidental status, appearing out of keeping and failing to respect the character, appearance and function of the host property, its plot and general pattern of development in the vicinity. The proposed development is therefore contrary to policies D12.3 and D12.4 of the Merton Local Plan (2024).

Reason : 2 - The proposed outbuilding by reason of its design, height, massing and siting would result in an unneighbourly form of development, resulting in an overly large and visually intrusive form of the development, creating a sense of enclosure and resulting in some loss of light, detrimental to the amenities of 1 Edgehill Road and 51 Sandy Lane. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies D12.3 and D12.4 of the Merton Local Plan (2024).

Reason : 3 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the NPPF, The London Borough of Merton  (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to development proposals focused on solutions. LBM works with applicants/agents in a positive and proactive manner by:
"	Offering a pre-application advice and duty desk service. 
"	Where possible, suggesting solutions to secure a successful outcome.
"	As appropriate, updating applicants/agents of any issues that may arise in the processing of their application.
In this instance:
"	The application was not considered to comply with the provisions of the Development Plan and NPPF as submitted, and would have required substantial changes such that a new application would be required. 
"	It is noted that the applicant/agent did not engage in any pre-application discussions.
"	The applicant is advised to seek pre-application advice on any resubmission.
description: DEMOLITION OF EXISTING SHEDS AND ERECTION OF NEW SINGLE STOREY OUTBUILDING AT THE END OF THE REAR GARDEN FOR USE INCIDENTAL TO MAIN DWELLINGHOUSE
